Class KMean

java.lang.Object
jwat.workloadAnalysis.clustering.kMean.KMean
All Implemented Interfaces:
JWATConstants, Clustering
public class KMean extends Object implements Clustering, JWATConstants
K-means clustering algorithm of JWAT: partitions the observations into k clusters around their centroids.
